INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  Library Board
  MINUTES –August 24, 2022

The Inglewood Library Board met on August 24, 2022 via Zoom. The meeting was called to order at 4:34 p.m. by
Chairman Patt Sanders.

Roll Call

Present:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman
  Julie Minton – District 1 Board Member, Vice Chairman
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member

Staff:
  Kerri Arroyo – Library Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Staff Assistant

Public Comments

  None

Approval of the Minutes

  Chairman Patt Sanders made a motion for the approval of the minutes for June 22, 2022.
  Board Member Minton seconded the motion.

  All in favor, motion passed.

  .
Board discussion items

  None

Library Report

  1
   Library Manager Kerri Arroyo provided the board members with a library update that included the hiring of
new librarians, internship, partnership with Parks and Recreation Department, going to Rogers and Darby Park to
deliver Summer Camp curriculum for kids; bilingual programming for seniors, adult, teens and children’s at Senior
Center and both libraries; Summer reading and the library mascot Tommy the turtle, activities, outreach, checkouts,
park passes and computer usage, accomplishments and Collection statistics.

  Board member Douglas asked if the library mascot lives at the library.
  Library Manager Kerri Arroyo stated that Tommy the turtle will be at the library occasionally, he stayed at
the library for 9 hours and was very tired, did not like being on the book truck.
  Board member Cochran went to Crenshaw library when they were having the lunch program and had a
very interesting experience. Library was very attractive and employees were very nice.

  Douglas stated that she visited Crenshaw library when they were having children’s program and was very
happy and had wonderful experience.

  Board member Douglas asked if there is a waiting list for the Chromebooks and if there are being returned
properly.
  Kerri explained that we have enough laptops and Chromebooks with seven day checkout and good
turnover.

Friends Report

  Susan Carleo, President of the Friends of Inglewood Public Library (FOIPL) gave a quick update on getting
donations from community; received 250 DVD’s from someone who was in the movie industry; thanked everyone
for book donations and ongoing support.

Public Comments

  None

Commissioner Comments

  Board members Sanders thanked Library Manager Kerri Arroyo for doing a great job.

  Board members Douglas and Cochran stated that Kerri and the library staff are doing amazing job.

  Kerri appreciated board members for the positive feedback and mentioned that it is very encouraging.

  With no further comments the meeting was adjourned at 5:03 p.m.
